run_training_loop: run the StyleNeRF GAN training loop with configurable generator, discriminator, and optimizer kwargs
run_training_loop_resume: resume the StyleNeRF training loop from a saved network pickle checkpoint file
run_training_loop_ada: run the training loop with adaptive data augmentation using a target discriminator score
setup_snapshot_image_grid: setup a snapshot image grid from a training dataset for visualization and evaluation
review_training_loop: review the training_loop function to understand its EMA, DDP, and lazy regularization logic
